purpose: Complement the six formal responsive views with exact two-sided breakpoint probes so off-by-one media-query regressions cannot hide between the broad captures.
browser_requirement: Requires a deterministic harness that can set exact CSS viewport width, with stable DPR/zoom/font/image/motion state. Current Opera connector does not expose viewport/DPR/zoom control, so these probes remain prepared until capable tooling is available.
probe_policy: At each pair, inspect only the components whose known source contract changes at that boundary. Do not reinterpret natural text wrapping elsewhere as a defect.

boundary_pairs.name: comparison two-to-one column

expect.901: comparison is 2 equal minmax(0,1fr) columns with 24px gap

invariants: equal-height behavior where two-column layout applies

boundary_pairs.name: request contact compact typography/padding

expect.561: contact button retains default right padding 24px and strong text 1.02rem; intrinsic width
expect.560: contact button right padding becomes 16px and strong text .92rem; width remains intrinsic/auto

invariants: white foreground if v006 is needed/deployed

boundary_pairs.name: request contact intrinsic-to-full width
invariants: 16px right padding and .92rem strong text on both widths

measurement_outputs: component bounding boxes for the affected grid/cards/buttons
computed column count or direct-child left/right geometry
computed request-button width/padding-right/font-size at 561/560/401/400 if the harness can expose computed styles
source and target screenshot for the affected component only when synchronized
interpretation_rules: A boundary mismatch must reproduce source-versus-target at the exact paired widths before it becomes a defect.
Do not add a new media query merely because the current tool cannot set the boundary width.
Do not alter visible copy or insert line breaks to make boundary wrapping look similar.
If a current prepared artifact changes the expected boundary contract, stop and reconcile it before deployment.

known_current_artifact_check.v004: Matches all listed known boundaries: problem grid contract is documented separately; comparison max900/max720; request max560/max400.
known_current_artifact_check.v007: Preserves max900 one-column comparison and does not alter max720 padding or request breakpoints.
known_current_artifact_check.v006: Color-only and cannot alter any boundary geometry.
